eval_spec.source_criteria: Use the actual Upwork job post page as the primary source. Information (title, posted time/date, budget, client location, and scope) must be directly supported by what is visible on the listing at time of collection.
eval_spec.row_rubric: Each row must: (1) be an open/active Upwork job; (2) have posted_date within 2026-03-08..2026-03-15 inclusive and formatted YYYY-MM-DD; (3) include a valid Upwork job_url; (4) job_title matches the listing; (5) summary is 1–2 sentences and accurately captures the dataset deliverable and method; (6) budget formatted as “Fixed: …” or “Hourly: …” with currency if shown, blank if not shown; (7) client_location matches listing or blank if missing.
eval_spec.cross_row_criteria: No duplicate job_url across rows. Maintain diversity of industries and dataset types within each group. Avoid near-duplicate questions/rows that describe essentially the same job pattern; prefer varied sources and scopes. Overall set should cover multiple ways of producing tabular datasets (scrape, research, clean, label, API/SQL).
eval_spec.critical_checks: Fail the row if: job is not open/active; posted_date is outside 2026-03-08..2026-03-15; any field is fabricated or inferred without support (especially budget/location); summary exceeds 2 sentences; budget includes a value when listing shows none; job_url is not a job post URL or is inaccessible/incorrect.
